relationships.subject: DR neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: chemogenetic inhibition of DR neurons decreased hyperalgesia during spontaneous heroin withdrawal in male and female C57/B6 mice

relationships.subject: DR GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: specific chemogenetic inhibition of DR-VGaT neurons blocked hyperalgesia during spontaneous heroin withdrawal in male and female mice

relationships.subject: heroin withdrawal
relationships.evidence_quote: we identified three major subtypes of DR neurons expressing μ-opioid receptors (MOR) that were activated in hyperalgesia during spontaneous withdrawal

key_findings: Chemogenetic inhibition of DR neurons, and specifically DR-VGaT GABAergic neurons, blocked hyperalgesia during spontaneous heroin withdrawal in male and female mice.
MOR-expressing DR neurons co-expressing VGaT, VGluT3, or VGluT3+TPH were activated during withdrawal hyperalgesia, whereas TPH-only MOR neurons were not.
